sanskrit_verse:
हतानां नृपगोविप्रैरन्वक्षं चात्मघातिनाम् ।
प्रोषिते कालशेषः स्यात् पूर्णे दत्त्वोदकं शुचिः ॥३.२१॥
transliteration: hatānāṃ nṛpa-go-viprair anvakṣaṃ cātmaghātinām / proṣite kālaśeṣaḥ syāt pūrṇe dattvodakaṃ śuciḥ // YajñS_3.21 //
sph_interpretive_translation: When a king, cow, or Brahmin has been killed, or when one has committed self-destruction, the residual time-period applicable is that which remains after full completion of the expiation process involving pure water offering.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in completion of dharma-aligned restitution before temporal consequences are measured
Causation flows from act-specific dharmic disruption requiring precise ritual restoration
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness at time of act and ability to perform corrective action
Restoration logic operates through sequential purification and reintegration protocols
Consciousness alignment occurs upon fulfillment of prescribed restorative acts
executable_legal_axioms: IF (act_type IN [killing_king, killing_cow, killing_brahmin, suicide]) THEN (trigger_expiation_protocol WITH purity_water_offering)
IF (purity_water_offered == TRUE AND consciousness_reintegrated == TRUE) THEN (declare_completion_of_consequence_phase)
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that even grave violations involving loss of life or self-destruction require resolution through precise dharmic expiation rather than punitive sentencing. The court must ensure that prescribed rituals are executed fully and verified for consciousness realignment prior to closure.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies disruption of sacred order; anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential purification; proportional responsibility lies in completing exact restorative sequence; non-punitive reality rule confirms suffering is not justice but distortion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Purity Water Offering Protocol under supervision of qualified Vedic authority
Monitor consciousness state progression using SPH-defined awareness metrics
Verify completion of all sequential purification rites as per scriptural mandate
Reintegrate individual into community only upon attestation of inner purity and outer conduct harmony
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law: Dharma is restored through precise execution of expiation, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness stands as ultimate adjudicator.
